summary: In this studio-style walkthrough, the presenter analyzes alpine landscape photographs and demonstrates a practical workflow for composition, sky handling, and post-processing in Photoshop. The session emphasizes foreground design using wide-angle cues (V and U shapes), careful spacing and rule-based layout, selection-free blending, sky grading with color and tonal adjustments, focus stacking considerations, and advanced layering techniques to create depth, mood, and leading light. Throughout, the instructor stresses the careful balance of light, dynamic range, and color to preserve eye flow and credible realism, while acknowledging the limitations and artifacts of focus stacking and extreme wide-angle distortion.
